name: dsh-professor-scan-steps
description: The deterministic scanned-exam steps (scans status, file, plan, names, apply) as one harness tool, run in the harness's process so they can write the private submissions folder the assistant's sandbox cannot.

comments.core: Declared where it is used; also a dependency of the project, as for dsh-ainar-course-model, because pnpm cannot resolve a file: spec whose absolute path contains a space.
